description: This is an entry-point source file for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component within a StrictMode wrapper into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React elements into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application into the specified DOM node.
